state_definitions.SUPPORTED: Required leads are observable, signal quality criteria are met, and the clinical diagnostic criteria are positively identified.
state_definitions.CONTRADICTED: Required leads are observable, signal quality criteria are met, but the specific diagnostic criteria are explicitly refuted or absent where expected.
state_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Required leads are masked, signal quality is inadequate (saturation/flatline), or required parent leads of a derived lead are missing.

CLAIM_NORMAL_ECG.verification_rule: heart_rate >= 60 and heart_rate <= 100 and pr_interval_ms >= 120 and pr_interval_ms <= 200 and qrs_duration_ms < 120 and not st_elevation and not st_depression and not t_wave_inversion
CLAIM_NORMAL_ECG.unavailable_condition: active_lead_count < 8 or any(l not in active_leads for l in ['II', 'V1'])
CLAIM_NORMAL_ECG.contradiction_condition: any(abnormality_detected) or heart_rate < 60 or heart_rate > 100 or qrs_duration_ms >= 120

measurement_requirement: absence of discrete organized P waves
CLAIM_AFIB.verification_rule: rr_cv > 0.20 and 'II' in active_leads or 'V1' in active_leads
CLAIM_AFIB.unavailable_condition: 'II' not in active_leads and 'V1' not in active_leads

CLAIM_RBBB.verification_rule: qrs_duration_ms >= 120 and ('V1' in active_leads and 'V6' in active_leads)
CLAIM_RBBB.unavailable_condition: 'V1' not in active_leads or 'V6' not in active_leads

CLAIM_LBBB.verification_rule: qrs_duration_ms >= 120 and (('I' in active_leads or 'V6' in active_leads) and 'V1' in active_leads)
CLAIM_LBBB.unavailable_condition: 'V1' not in active_leads and 'V6' not in active_leads

CLAIM_SINUS_BRADYCARDIA.verification_rule: heart_rate is not None and heart_rate < 60 and 'II' in active_leads
CLAIM_SINUS_BRADYCARDIA.unavailable_condition: 'II' not in active_leads and 'V1' not in active_leads and 'I' not in active_leads

CLAIM_SINUS_TACHYCARDIA.verification_rule: heart_rate is not None and heart_rate > 100 and 'II' in active_leads
CLAIM_SINUS_TACHYCARDIA.unavailable_condition: 'II' not in active_leads and 'V1' not in active_leads and 'I' not in active_leads

CLAIM_FIRST_DEGREE_AV_BLOCK.verification_rule: pr_interval_ms is not None and pr_interval_ms > 200 and 'II' in active_leads
CLAIM_FIRST_DEGREE_AV_BLOCK.unavailable_condition: 'II' not in active_leads and 'V1' not in active_leads
CLAIM_FIRST_DEGREE_AV_BLOCK.contradiction_condition: pr_interval_ms is not None and pr_interval_ms <= 200

measurement_requirement: st_elevation >= 0.10 mV (1 mm) in >= 2 contiguous anatomical leads
or pathological Q waves (duration >= 40 ms or amplitude >= 25% of R wave)
CLAIM_MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION.verification_rule: st_elevation.present and len(st_elevation.leads) >= 2 in contiguous territory
CLAIM_MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION.unavailable_condition: no contiguous lead pairs active in any anatomical territory (Inferior: [II, III, aVF], Anterior: [V3, V4], Septal: [V1, V2], Lateral: [I, aVL, V5, V6])
CLAIM_MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION.contradiction_condition: all contiguous leads active but st_deviation < 0.05 mV and no pathological Q waves
